label: update gate dips after rewarded trials (esp. S2-rewarded) at D1/GO, rises after unrewarded
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 27. Timing (falls over the episode, near 1 at D2) gives R^2 0.89; beyond timing the magnitude is set mainly by the previous trial's choice/state/reward at D1 and GO (D2 hardly varies). At D1 a rewarded previous trial lowers z, most after reaching S2 (a1 S2 r, a2 S2 r about -0.12/-0.13), while unrewarded trials raise it, most after reaching S1 (a1 S1 u +0.19, a2 S1 u +0.10); at GO unrewarded trials (a2 S1 u, a1 S1 u, a2 S2 u) raise it and a1 S1 r / a1 S2 r lower it. The last-trial tables alone score 0.58 dev; letting them grow with episode decade, adding the trial before (rewarded S2 / unrewarded S1) and the ideal-observer belief log-odds (D1 positive, GO negative, scaled with time) brings test R^2 beyond timing to 0.60 (ceiling all 0.67, all observed 0.64). Belief itself adds only ~0.01 beyond the last-trial pattern; the earlier model-policy cue (policy decile reference 0.36) is not needed, so observed-only loses little. Residual misses are long reward streaks late in the episode where z falls further than predicted.

issues: Minor overclaim in the label. 'z dips after rewarded trials' does not hold for every pattern. At D1, a1 S1 r has residual +0.058, so z goes up. At GO, a2 S1 r (-0.002) and a2 S2 r (-0.007) are about zero, so the GO dip after reward only shows up after a1 choices (a1 S1 r -0.064, a1 S2 r -0.096). The D1 pattern fits two additive effects better: reaching S1 raises z and a reward lowers it. The explanation text gets the tables right; the label simplifies them.

'D2 barely varies' holds only for most of the episode. Late in the episode (deciles 8-9, D2 baseline falls to 0.82), D2 errors are common among the worst-fit windows: actual 0.55-0.75 against predicted 0.82, mostly after reaching S1. Adding (phase==D2)*(state==S1)*late and (phase==D2)*(prev_reward==1)*late raises test R^2 from 0.596 to 0.612. The gain is small but real.

The trial-before terms add almost nothing. On test, tables+decile score 0.596, adding the two trial-before terms gives 0.598, and their fitted weights are -0.003 and +0.014. Belief x decile adds about 0.006 (0.596 -> 0.602), which matches the claim. These two components are close to negligible.

The residual misses are framed as 'long reward streaks late in the episode', but a reward-streak count x ep_dec term at D1/GO adds only 0.003 (0.599). The late-episode error is better described as general late-episode drift (including at D2) than as reward streaks.

Checks that passed: the reported score reproduces exactly (test 0.6045); the last-trial tables alone score 0.577 on test; the misses tool's mean error per phase is at most 0.002 and per (phase, previous trial) at most 0.014, so no large systematic class remains; no future variables are used; the belief weight signs (positive at D1, negative at GO) match.
skeptic.revised_label: At D1/GO, z goes up after reaching S1 and down after a reward. The most extreme cases are S1 unrewarded (+) and S2 rewarded (-), and the effect grows over the episode. Late in the episode z also dips at D2 after reaching S1.
skeptic.better_terms: D1 table ;; GO table ;; D1 table * ep_dec ;; GO table * ep_dec ;; (phase==D2)*(state==S1)*table(ep_dec,{7:0.3,8:1.0,9:3.0}) ;; (phase==D2)*(prev_reward==1)*table(ep_dec,{7:0.3,8:1.0,9:3.0}) ;; (phase != D2)*belief_lo*ep_dec*np.where(phase==D1,1,-1)  (tables as in the original terms)
